title: Саша переезжает к Максу и Косте  (Sasha Moves In with Max and Kostya)

segments.t: Feeling responsible for the flood, Max invites Sasha to move into his apartment with him and Kostya. Although Sasha first suspects he is only asking out of guilt, she happily accepts and starts kissing him right on the kitchen table as Kostya walks in.
Я сама разберусь со своими проблемами, правда.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'Listen, I have been thinking.' In Russian, the idea of 'listen' flows naturally into 'would think' without extra filler words.
'Will you move in with me?' Notice how Russian expresses 'you' and 'to cross' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'You just feel guilty.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'fault'. Kostya answers right away.
Я сама разберусь со своими проблемами, правда.
'I can handle my own problems myself, really.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'honestly' in spoken Russian.
'I am not asking because of that.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'of this' in spoken Russian.
'I have wanted to offer this to you for a long time.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'you' without extra filler words. Max answers right away.
'Well, are you sure about it yourself?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'sure'.
'Why would I not be?' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'why' in a few short words.
'Why am I wasting time for nothing?' Notice how Russian expresses 'why' and 'to lose' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Kostya answers right away.
'Maybe right here?' In Russian, the idea of 'maybe' flows naturally into 'here' without extra filler words.
'Do not mind me.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'not' before landing on 'attention'.
'I did not see you two.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'saw' without extra filler words. Max answers right away.
'Kostik, close your eyes.' The meaning hinges on 'Kostik' working together with 'eyes' in spoken Russian. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Я сама разберусь со своими проблемами, правда.
